# Serra Azul Logistica S.A.

Serra Azul is a synthetic Brazilian logistics operator serving industrial
customers in Sao Paulo, Minas Gerais, and Parana. The company owns 42 trucks,
leases 18 additional vehicles, and operates three distribution hubs.

For the synthetic transaction, the shareholders are evaluating a 100% sell-side
process. No customer, employee, or real company information appears in this
file.
